analysis.narrativeEn:

· SMA100/200($1.16/$1.27) comparison: Maintaining strong long-term trend strength

[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance ($1.47) + 5-day high resistance zone
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (sideways) + Trend reversal confirmation needed
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation Zone) + Buy entry conditions not met, maintaining wait-and-see stance
